name: Sister Miransha no Ecchi na Gohoushi 2nd
original_name: シスターミランシャのえっちなご奉仕2nd
source:
A short 10-15 minute work from Yoru no Hitsuji.
You meet a loli nun in a church. Her eyes seem to suggest more than her calm demeanor...
